name: condi
description: Ask ChatGPT about the condition you track in Condi — today's Condi Score and HRV-based recovery, HRV and resting heart rate trends, training load, daily health totals and your logged records.

interface.longDescription:
Condi is a condition and recovery app built on the HRV and sleep data from your Apple Watch. Connect your Condi account and ask ChatGPT about your own condition — it reads what Condi has recorded and helps you make sense of it.

What you can do
• Check today's condition — your Condi Score, your HRV-based recovery level (overload, caution, normal or recovered) and how recovery, rhythm, activity and fuel add up.
• See trends — daily HRV and resting heart rate against your 60-day baseline, and how your condition changed over recent weeks.
• Review training load — this week's load compared with last week, and whether it is balanced.
• Summarize daily totals — sleep, steps, exercise, calories, water, caffeine and weight.
• Look up records you logged in Condi — weight, water, caffeine, meals, sleep and workouts.

How connecting works
When you connect, you approve the connection in the Condi app on your iPhone (tap the button, or scan the QR code on a computer) and check that the confirmation code matches. The connection is read-only: ChatGPT can't change your Condi records or settings, and you can disconnect at any time.

Good to know
Condi provides wellness information, not medical advice. Logging records and changing goals happen in the Condi app. Connecting requires the latest version of Condi.
capabilities: Explain today's condition and Condi Score
Track HRV and resting heart rate trends
Summarize daily sleep, steps and calories
Look up logged meals, water and workouts
defaultPrompt: How is my condition today in Condi?
How has my HRV changed over the last two weeks?
Summarize my sleep and steps this week from Condi.

positive.description: Explain today's condition from the connected account.
positive.prompt: How is my condition today in Condi?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports today's Condi Score, the HRV-based recovery level (overload, caution, normal or recovered) with the change versus the user's baseline, and the recovery, rhythm, activity and fuel scores — or says which parts lack data — without giving medical advice.

positive.description: Show the HRV and resting heart rate trend for a period.
positive.prompt: How has my HRV changed over the last two weeks in Condi?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists daily HRV (and resting heart rate where available) for the last 14 days from the test account's sample data and compares the period average with the 60-day HRV baseline.

positive.description: Summarize daily health totals for a week.
positive.prompt: Summarize my sleep, steps and water from Condi for the past 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives sleep minutes, steps and water for each day that has data and the weekly averages, and describes missing values as not recorded rather than zero.

positive.description: Look up individual records logged in Condi.
positive.prompt: What meals and caffeine did I log in Condi yesterday?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists yesterday's meals with time, meal type, food name and calories, and the caffeine entries with time and milligrams, from the test account's records.

positive.prompt: Is my training load balanced this week according to Condi?
positive.expected_behavior: Compares this week's load with last week's, states the load ratio band (below_usual, balanced, elevated or very_high) and today's training score if available, describing it as training balance and not as injury risk.

negative.description: The app is read-only. Logging water or changing goals must be done in the Condi app; the assistant should say so and not claim to have changed anything.
negative.prompt: Log 500 ml of water in Condi and change my sleep goal to 8 hours.

negative.description: The app only reads the connected user's own data. The assistant should decline requests about another person's data.
negative.prompt: Show me my friend's HRV and condition from Condi.

negative.description: Condi provides wellness information, not diagnoses. The assistant should not diagnose a heart condition from HRV data and should suggest seeing a doctor for concerns.
negative.prompt: My HRV dropped this week in Condi. Do I have a heart problem? Diagnose me.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only access to your Condi condition — today's Condi Score and HRV-based recovery, HRV and resting heart rate trends, training load, daily health totals and the records you logged in Condi.

ko-KR.subtitle: 내 컨디션과 HRV를 물어보세요
ko-KR.description:
Condi는 Apple Watch의 HRV와 수면 데이터를 바탕으로 컨디션과 회복을 관리하는 앱이에요. Condi 계정을 연결하면 ChatGPT에게 내 컨디션을 물어볼 수 있어요. ChatGPT가 Condi에 쌓인 기록을 읽고 이해하기 쉽게 정리해 줘요.

할 수 있는 일
• 오늘의 컨디션 — Condi Score, HRV 기반 회복 단계(과부하·주의·정상·회복됨), 회복·리듬·활력·연료 세부 점수
• 추이 — 60일 기준선과 비교한 일별 HRV·안정시 심박수, 최근 몇 주의 컨디션 변화
• 훈련 부하 — 이번 주 부하를 지난주와 비교하고 균형이 맞는지 확인
• 일별 합계 — 수면, 걸음 수, 운동, 칼로리, 물, 카페인, 체중
• Condi에 남긴 기록 — 체중, 물, 카페인, 식사, 수면, 운동

연결 방법
연결할 때 iPhone의 Condi 앱에서 승인해요(폰은 버튼, 컴퓨터는 QR 코드). 확인 코드가 같은지 확인해 주세요. 연결은 읽기 전용이라 ChatGPT가 Condi의 기록이나 설정을 바꾸지 않고, 언제든 연결을 끊을 수 있어요.

알아 두세요
Condi는 웰니스 정보를 제공하며 의학적 조언이 아니에요. 기록 추가와 목표 변경은 Condi 앱에서 해 주세요. 연결하려면 Condi 최신 버전이 필요해요.

ja-JP.subtitle: コンディションとHRVを質問
ja-JP.description:
Condiは、Apple WatchのHRV（心拍変動）と睡眠データをもとにコンディションと回復を管理するアプリです。Condiアカウントを連携すると、ChatGPTに自分のコンディションについて質問できます。ChatGPTがCondiに記録されたデータを読み取り、わかりやすく整理します。

できること
• 今日のコンディション — Condi Score、HRVにもとづく回復レベル（過負荷・注意・通常・回復）、回復・リズム・活動・燃料の内訳
• 推移 — 60日間のベースラインと比べた日ごとのHRV・安静時心拍数、ここ数週間のコンディションの変化
• トレーニング負荷 — 今週の負荷を先週と比べ、バランスが取れているかを確認
• 毎日の合計 — 睡眠、歩数、運動、カロリー、水分、カフェイン、体重
• Condiに記録した内容 — 体重、水分、カフェイン、食事、睡眠、ワークアウト

連携方法
連携時にiPhoneのCondiアプリで承認します（スマホはボタン、パソコンはQRコード）。確認コードが一致することを確認してください。連携は閲覧のみで、ChatGPTがCondiの記録や設定を変更することはありません。いつでも連携を解除できます。

ご注意
Condiはウェルネス情報を提供するもので、医学的なアドバイスではありません。記録の追加や目標の変更はCondiアプリで行ってください。連携にはCondiの最新バージョンが必要です。

zh-TW.subtitle: 查詢你的身體狀態與 HRV
zh-TW.description:
Condi 是一款以 Apple Watch 的心率變異度（HRV）與睡眠資料為基礎，管理身體狀態與恢復的 App。連結 Condi 帳號後，你就能向 ChatGPT 詢問自己的身體狀態。ChatGPT 會讀取你在 Condi 中的紀錄，並整理成容易理解的內容。

可以做什麼
• 今天的狀態 — Condi Score、以 HRV 為基礎的恢復等級（過度負荷、注意、正常、已恢復），以及恢復、節律、活力、能量各項分數
• 趨勢 — 與 60 天基準比較的每日 HRV 與靜止心率，以及近幾週的狀態變化
• 訓練負荷 — 比較本週與上週的負荷，確認是否均衡
• 每日總計 — 睡眠、步數、運動、熱量、飲水、咖啡因與體重
• 你在 Condi 中記錄的內容 — 體重、飲水、咖啡因、飲食、睡眠與運動

連結方式
連結時，請在 iPhone 的 Condi App 中核准（手機點按鈕，電腦掃描 QR Code），並確認驗證碼相同。連結僅供讀取，ChatGPT 不會變更你在 Condi 的紀錄或設定，你也可以隨時中斷連結。

注意事項
Condi 提供的是健康生活資訊，並非醫療建議。新增紀錄與變更目標請在 Condi App 中進行。連結需要最新版本的 Condi。

• 每日總數 — 睡眠、步數、運動、熱量、飲水、咖啡因及體重

zh-CN.subtitle: 查询你的身体状态和 HRV
zh-CN.description:
Condi 是一款基于 Apple Watch 心率变异性（HRV）和睡眠数据来管理身体状态与恢复的 App。连接 Condi 账号后，你就可以向 ChatGPT 询问自己的身体状态。ChatGPT 会读取你在 Condi 中的记录，并整理成容易理解的内容。

可以做什么
• 今天的状态 — Condi Score、基于 HRV 的恢复等级（过度负荷、注意、正常、已恢复），以及恢复、节律、活力、能量各项分数
• 趋势 — 与 60 天基线对比的每日 HRV 和静息心率，以及最近几周的状态变化
• 训练负荷 — 对比本周与上周的负荷，看看是否均衡
• 每日汇总 — 睡眠、步数、运动、热量、饮水、咖啡因和体重
• 你在 Condi 中记录的内容 — 体重、饮水、咖啡因、饮食、睡眠和运动

连接方式
连接时，请在 iPhone 上的 Condi App 中批准（手机点按钮，电脑扫描二维码），并确认验证码一致。连接仅供读取，ChatGPT 不会更改你在 Condi 中的记录或设置，你也可以随时断开连接。

注意事项
Condi 提供的是健康生活信息，并非医疗建议。添加记录和更改目标请在 Condi App 中进行。连接需要最新版本的 Condi。

de-DE.subtitle: Frag nach Zustand und HRV
de-DE.description:
Condi ist eine App für Tagesform und Erholung, die auf den HRV- und Schlafdaten deiner Apple Watch basiert. Verbinde dein Condi-Konto und frag ChatGPT nach deiner eigenen Verfassung – ChatGPT liest, was Condi aufgezeichnet hat, und hilft dir, es zu verstehen.

Was du tun kannst
• Heutige Verfassung prüfen – dein Condi Score, deine HRV-basierte Erholungsstufe (Überlastung, Vorsicht, normal oder erholt) und wie sich Erholung, Rhythmus, Aktivität und Energie zusammensetzen.
• Verläufe sehen – tägliche HRV und Ruhepuls im Vergleich zu deinem 60-Tage-Basiswert und wie sich deine Verfassung in den letzten Wochen verändert hat.
• Trainingsbelastung prüfen – die Belastung dieser Woche im Vergleich zur Vorwoche und ob sie ausgewogen ist.
• Tageswerte zusammenfassen – Schlaf, Schritte, Training, Kalorien, Wasser, Koffein und Gewicht.
• In Condi erfasste Einträge nachschlagen – Gewicht, Wasser, Koffein, Mahlzeiten, Schlaf und Workouts.

So funktioniert die Verbindung
Beim Verbinden bestätigst du die Verbindung in der Condi-App auf deinem iPhone (Button antippen oder auf dem Computer den QR-Code scannen) und prüfst, ob der Bestätigungscode übereinstimmt. Die Verbindung ist schreibgeschützt: ChatGPT kann deine Condi-Einträge und Einstellungen nicht ändern, und du kannst die Verbindung jederzeit trennen.

Gut zu wissen
Condi liefert Wellness-Informationen, keine medizinische Beratung. Einträge erfassen und Ziele ändern geht in der Condi-App. Für die Verbindung brauchst du die neueste Version von Condi.

fr-FR.subtitle: Votre forme et votre VFC
fr-FR.description:
Condi est une application de suivi de la forme et de la récupération, basée sur les données de VFC (variabilité de la fréquence cardiaque) et de sommeil de votre Apple Watch. Connectez votre compte Condi et posez vos questions à ChatGPT sur votre propre forme : il lit ce que Condi a enregistré et vous aide à l'interpréter.

Ce que vous pouvez faire
• Consulter votre forme du jour : votre Condi Score, votre niveau de récupération basé sur la VFC (surcharge, prudence, normal ou récupéré) et la contribution de la récupération, du rythme, de l'activité et de l'énergie.
• Voir les tendances : VFC et fréquence cardiaque au repos jour par jour par rapport à votre référence sur 60 jours, et l'évolution de votre forme ces dernières semaines.
• Examiner la charge d'entraînement : la charge de cette semaine comparée à la semaine dernière, et si elle est équilibrée.
• Résumer vos totaux quotidiens : sommeil, pas, exercice, calories, eau, caféine et poids.
• Retrouver les données saisies dans Condi : poids, eau, caféine, repas, sommeil et entraînements.

Comment se connecter
Lors de la connexion, vous l'approuvez dans l'app Condi sur votre iPhone (touchez le bouton, ou scannez le QR code depuis un ordinateur) en vérifiant que le code de confirmation est identique. La connexion est en lecture seule : ChatGPT ne peut pas modifier vos données ni vos réglages Condi, et vous pouvez vous déconnecter à tout moment.

Bon à savoir
Condi fournit des informations de bien-être, pas des conseils médicaux. L'ajout de données et la modification des objectifs se font dans l'app Condi. La connexion nécessite la dernière version de Condi.

es-ES.subtitle: Consulta tu estado y tu VFC
es-ES.description:
Condi es una app de estado físico y recuperación basada en los datos de VFC (variabilidad de la frecuencia cardíaca) y sueño de tu Apple Watch. Conecta tu cuenta de Condi y pregúntale a ChatGPT sobre tu propio estado: lee lo que Condi ha registrado y te ayuda a entenderlo.

Qué puedes hacer
• Consultar tu estado de hoy: tu Condi Score, tu nivel de recuperación basado en la VFC (sobrecarga, precaución, normal o recuperado) y cómo contribuyen la recuperación, el ritmo, la actividad y la energía.
• Ver tendencias: VFC y frecuencia cardíaca en reposo diarias frente a tu referencia de 60 días, y cómo ha cambiado tu estado en las últimas semanas.
• Revisar la carga de entrenamiento: la carga de esta semana comparada con la anterior y si está equilibrada.
• Resumir tus totales diarios: sueño, pasos, ejercicio, calorías, agua, cafeína y peso.
• Consultar lo que registraste en Condi: peso, agua, cafeína, comidas, sueño y entrenamientos.

Cómo funciona la conexión
Al conectar, apruebas la conexión en la app Condi de tu iPhone (toca el botón o escanea el código QR desde un ordenador) y compruebas que el código de confirmación coincide. La conexión es de solo lectura: ChatGPT no puede cambiar tus registros ni tus ajustes de Condi, y puedes desconectarla en cualquier momento.

Ten en cuenta
Condi ofrece información de bienestar, no consejo médico. Añadir registros y cambiar objetivos se hace en la app Condi. Para conectar necesitas la última versión de Condi.

tr-TR.subtitle: Kondisyonunu ve HRV'ni sor
tr-TR.description:
Condi, Apple Watch'unun HRV (kalp atış hızı değişkenliği) ve uyku verilerine dayanan bir kondisyon ve toparlanma uygulamasıdır. Condi hesabını bağla ve ChatGPT'ye kendi kondisyonunu sor; ChatGPT, Condi'nin kaydettiklerini okur ve anlamana yardımcı olur.

Neler yapabilirsin
• Bugünkü kondisyonunu gör: Condi Score'un, HRV'ye dayalı toparlanma seviyen (aşırı yük, dikkat, normal veya toparlanmış) ve toparlanma, ritim, aktivite ve yakıtın katkısı.
• Eğilimleri gör: 60 günlük referansına göre günlük HRV ve dinlenme nabzı, son haftalarda kondisyonunun nasıl değiştiği.
• Antrenman yükünü incele: bu haftanın yükünü geçen haftayla karşılaştır ve dengeli olup olmadığını gör.
• Günlük toplamları özetle: uyku, adım, egzersiz, kalori, su, kafein ve kilo.
• Condi'de kaydettiklerine bak: kilo, su, kafein, öğünler, uyku ve antrenmanlar.

Bağlantı nasıl çalışır
Bağlanırken bağlantıyı iPhone'undaki Condi uygulamasında onaylarsın (düğmeye dokun veya bilgisayarda QR kodunu tara) ve onay kodunun aynı olduğunu kontrol edersin. Bağlantı salt okunurdur: ChatGPT Condi kayıtlarını veya ayarlarını değiştiremez ve bağlantıyı istediğin zaman kesebilirsin.

Bilmende fayda var
Condi tıbbi tavsiye değil, sağlıklı yaşam bilgisi sunar. Kayıt ekleme ve hedef değiştirme Condi uygulamasında yapılır. Bağlanmak için Condi'nin en son sürümü gerekir.

ar-SA.subtitle: اسأل عن حالتك وتقلب نبضك
ar-SA.description:
Condi تطبيق لمتابعة الحالة البدنية والتعافي يعتمد على بيانات تقلب معدل ضربات القلب (HRV) والنوم من Apple Watch. اربط حسابك في Condi واسأل ChatGPT عن حالتك؛ فهو يقرأ ما سجّله Condi ويساعدك على فهمه.

ما يمكنك فعله
• معرفة حالتك اليوم: Condi Score ومستوى التعافي المعتمد على HRV (إجهاد زائد، تنبيه، طبيعي، متعافٍ) ومساهمة التعافي والإيقاع والنشاط والطاقة.
• متابعة الاتجاهات: HRV ومعدل نبض الراحة يومًا بيوم مقارنةً بخط الأساس لمدة 60 يومًا، وكيف تغيّرت حالتك في الأسابيع الأخيرة.
• مراجعة حِمل التدريب: حِمل هذا الأسبوع مقارنةً بالأسبوع الماضي ومدى توازنه.
• تلخيص المجاميع اليومية: النوم والخطوات والتمرين والسعرات والماء والكافيين والوزن.
• الاطلاع على ما سجّلته في Condi: الوزن والماء والكافيين والوجبات والنوم والتمارين.

كيف يعمل الربط
عند الربط توافق عليه في تطبيق Condi على iPhone (اضغط الزر، أو امسح رمز QR من الكمبيوتر) وتتأكد من تطابق رمز التأكيد. الربط للقراءة فقط: لا يستطيع ChatGPT تغيير سجلاتك أو إعداداتك في Condi، ويمكنك إلغاء الربط في أي وقت.

معلومة مهمة
يقدّم Condi معلومات عافية وليس نصيحة طبية. إضافة السجلات وتغيير الأهداف تتم في تطبيق Condi. يتطلب الربط أحدث إصدار من Condi.

it-IT.subtitle: Chiedi della tua forma e HRV
it-IT.description:
Condi è un'app per la forma e il recupero basata sui dati HRV (variabilità della frequenza cardiaca) e sul sonno del tuo Apple Watch. Collega il tuo account Condi e chiedi a ChatGPT della tua forma: legge ciò che Condi ha registrato e ti aiuta a interpretarlo.

Cosa puoi fare
• Controllare la forma di oggi: il tuo Condi Score, il livello di recupero basato sull'HRV (sovraccarico, attenzione, normale o recuperato) e il contributo di recupero, ritmo, attività ed energia.
• Vedere le tendenze: HRV e frequenza cardiaca a riposo giorno per giorno rispetto al tuo riferimento di 60 giorni, e come è cambiata la tua forma nelle ultime settimane.
• Valutare il carico di allenamento: il carico di questa settimana rispetto alla precedente e se è equilibrato.
• Riassumere i totali giornalieri: sonno, passi, esercizio, calorie, acqua, caffeina e peso.
• Consultare ciò che hai registrato in Condi: peso, acqua, caffeina, pasti, sonno e allenamenti.

Come funziona il collegamento
Quando ti colleghi, approvi il collegamento nell'app Condi sul tuo iPhone (tocca il pulsante o, dal computer, scansiona il codice QR) e verifichi che il codice di conferma coincida. Il collegamento è di sola lettura: ChatGPT non può modificare i tuoi dati o le impostazioni di Condi e puoi scollegarti in qualsiasi momento.

Da sapere
Condi fornisce informazioni sul benessere, non consigli medici. L'inserimento dei dati e la modifica degli obiettivi si fanno nell'app Condi. Per collegarti serve l'ultima versione di Condi.

nl-NL.subtitle: Vraag naar je conditie en HRV
nl-NL.description:
Condi is een app voor conditie en herstel, gebaseerd op de HRV- en slaapgegevens van je Apple Watch. Koppel je Condi-account en vraag ChatGPT naar je eigen conditie: ChatGPT leest wat Condi heeft vastgelegd en helpt je het te begrijpen.

Wat je kunt doen
• Je conditie van vandaag bekijken: je Condi Score, je op HRV gebaseerde herstelniveau (overbelast, opletten, normaal of hersteld) en hoe herstel, ritme, activiteit en brandstof bijdragen.
• Trends zien: dagelijkse HRV en rusthartslag ten opzichte van je basiswaarde over 60 dagen, en hoe je conditie de afgelopen weken veranderde.
• Trainingsbelasting bekijken: de belasting van deze week vergeleken met vorige week, en of die in balans is.
• Dagtotalen samenvatten: slaap, stappen, beweging, calorieën, water, cafeïne en gewicht.
• Opzoeken wat je in Condi hebt vastgelegd: gewicht, water, cafeïne, maaltijden, slaap en workouts.

Zo werkt koppelen
Bij het koppelen keur je de koppeling goed in de Condi-app op je iPhone (tik op de knop of scan op een computer de QR-code) en controleer je of de bevestigingscode overeenkomt. De koppeling is alleen-lezen: ChatGPT kan je Condi-gegevens en -instellingen niet wijzigen, en je kunt de koppeling altijd verbreken.

Goed om te weten
Condi geeft wellnessinformatie, geen medisch advies. Gegevens vastleggen en doelen wijzigen doe je in de Condi-app. Voor het koppelen heb je de nieuwste versie van Condi nodig.

ro-RO.subtitle: Întreabă de forma ta și HRV
ro-RO.description:
Condi este o aplicație pentru formă și recuperare, bazată pe datele HRV (variabilitatea ritmului cardiac) și de somn de pe Apple Watch. Conectează-ți contul Condi și întreabă-l pe ChatGPT despre propria formă: citește ce a înregistrat Condi și te ajută să înțelegi datele.

Ce poți face
• Verifici forma de azi: Condi Score, nivelul de recuperare bazat pe HRV (suprasolicitare, atenție, normal sau recuperat) și contribuția recuperării, ritmului, activității și energiei.
• Vezi tendințele: HRV și pulsul în repaus zi de zi față de referința ta pe 60 de zile, și cum s-a schimbat forma ta în ultimele săptămâni.
• Analizezi încărcarea la antrenament: încărcarea din această săptămână comparată cu săptămâna trecută și dacă este echilibrată.
• Rezumi totalurile zilnice: somn, pași, exerciții, calorii, apă, cofeină și greutate.
• Cauți ce ai înregistrat în Condi: greutate, apă, cofeină, mese, somn și antrenamente.

Cum funcționează conectarea
Când te conectezi, aprobi conexiunea în aplicația Condi de pe iPhone (atinge butonul sau scanează codul QR de pe computer) și verifici că codul de confirmare este același. Conexiunea este doar pentru citire: ChatGPT nu îți poate modifica înregistrările sau setările din Condi și te poți deconecta oricând.

Bine de știut
Condi oferă informații de wellness, nu sfaturi medicale. Adăugarea înregistrărilor și schimbarea obiectivelor se fac în aplicația Condi. Pentru conectare ai nevoie de cea mai nouă versiune Condi.
